name: Samadhi of Hambirrao Mohite
description: The samadhi (tomb) of Hambirrao Mohite, the legendary Senapati (commander-in-chief) of the Maratha Empire under Shivaji Maharaj and Sambhaji Maharaj. Renowned for his military genius and loyalty, Hambirrao played a crucial role in Maratha victories.
historicalSignificance: Final resting place of Hambirrao Mohite, a key Maratha general and statesman.

landmarks.name: Hambirrao Mohite Samadhi
landmarks.description: Simple but revered tomb, visited by Maratha history enthusiasts.

reviews: A place of pride for Marathas.
Important for those interested in Maratha history.
